blurb:
Mobsters, flamingos, a massive sphere, the Roman Empire and a gondola from Venice, Italy. In any other city this combination of words would have you convinced that you're in a lucid dream, but in Vegas that's just a normal Tuesday evening.

Maybe you've been to Las Vegas before or maybe you've just seen it in the movies, regardless, Sin City is more than meets the eye. Every mega-resort has it's secrets and hidden gems that most walk right past, or over, or under.

We'll show you Vegas like you've never seen it before on your small group walking tour with vibrant art hidden in the shadows, stops at historical markers, and the best photo spots to make everyone back home jealous (did we mention the FREE photo print?). 

This isn't a historical tour, this is the best way to experience Las Vegas by seeing it from the inside out with an experienced local whose #1 goal is to make sure you have fun. Come have a drink on us, get those steps in, and learn a thing or two!
